returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.summary: You may return most unused items within 30 days of delivery, no reason needed. Customers in the EU/Sweden additionally have a mandatory 14-day statutory right of withdrawal and a separate statutory right to claim for faulty goods for up to 3 years. Full details below.

sections.heading: Our Standard Return Policy
sections.text: Most items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for any reason, provided they are unused and in resalable condition with original packaging where practical. We do not charge a restocking fee. Contact us with your order number to start a return.

sections.heading: Statutory Right of Withdrawal — EU & Swedish Customers
sections.text: Under the Swedish Distance and Off-Premises Contracts Act (distansavtalslagen) and the EU Consumer Rights Directive, you have the right to withdraw from your purchase within 14 days of receiving your goods, without giving any reason. To exercise this right, tell us clearly (e.g. by email to cool@arcticflow.com) that you wish to withdraw, then return the goods within a further 14 days. We will refund the full purchase price, including the standard delivery cost you paid, within 14 days of receiving the goods back or proof that you have sent them. You are responsible for the direct cost of returning the goods. We may reduce the refund to reflect any loss in value caused by handling the goods beyond what is necessary to check their nature and function. Sealed goods that are not suitable for return for health or hygiene reasons — for example, pool or spa chemicals — are excluded from the right of withdrawal once the seal is broken after delivery; this is disclosed on the relevant product pages.

sections.heading: Statutory Warranty for Faulty Goods (Reklamationsrätt)
sections.text: Separately from the return windows above, Swedish and EU law gives you the right to claim for goods that are faulty or do not match their description for up to 3 years after purchase (Konsumentköplagen / the EU Sale of Goods Directive). If a fault appears, contact us and we will offer a repair, replacement, price reduction, or refund as appropriate. This statutory right exists regardless of any return deadline stated above and is not limited by it.

sections.heading: How to Start a Return or Warranty Claim
sections.text: Email cool@arcticflow.com with your order number and reason for the return or claim. We will respond within 2 business days with return instructions. You do not need to wait for an authorization number before sending goods back, though including your order number helps us process it faster.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.text: Refunds are issued to your original payment method. For EU/Swedish withdrawals, refunds are issued within 14 days as described above. For other returns, refunds are issued within 14 days of us receiving the item.

sections.heading: Damaged, Faulty, or Wrong Items
sections.text: If you receive a damaged, faulty, or incorrect item, contact us with photos as soon as possible. We will arrange a free replacement or full refund, including original delivery cost, at no cost to you. This is separate from — and does not reduce — your statutory warranty rights above.

sections.heading: Customers Outside the EU (Including the US)
sections.text: US law does not generally require a cooling-off period for regular retail purchases, but we apply the same 30-day standard return policy described above to all customers regardless of location. Some US states provide additional consumer protections that continue to apply.

sections.heading: If We Can't Resolve It
sections.text: Swedish and EU customers may bring an unresolved dispute to the National Board for Consumer Disputes (Allmänna reklamationsnämnden, ARN, www.arn.se) or use the EU Online Dispute Resolution platform at ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr. Using these services is free and does not require a lawyer.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.summary: Orders ship within 1–3 business days. Delivery typically takes 7–21 business days depending on supplier location. Cross-border orders may be subject to customs duties or import VAT.

sections.heading: Processing Time
sections.text: Orders are processed within 1–3 business days. You will receive a confirmation email with tracking once your order ships.

sections.heading: Delivery Estimates
sections.text: Standard delivery: 7–14 business days. Extended delivery: 14–21 business days for items fulfilled internationally. These are estimates, not guarantees.

sections.heading: Shipping Costs
sections.text: Shipping costs, if any, are shown at checkout before you pay. All prices shown include 25% VAT (moms) where applicable.

sections.heading: Customs, Duties & Import VAT
sections.text: If your order is fulfilled from a supplier outside your country (including outside the EU), it may be subject to customs duties or import VAT collected by the carrier or customs authority on delivery. These charges are not included in our prices and are your responsibility as the importer of record, unless we state otherwise at checkout.

sections.heading: Lost or Delayed Packages
sections.text: If tracking shows no movement for 10+ business days, contact us and we will work with the carrier and supplier to resolve it. This does not affect your statutory rights if the goods never arrive — you remain entitled to a replacement or refund.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.summary: By purchasing from us you agree to these terms. Nothing here limits any statutory right you have under Swedish, EU, or other applicable consumer law.

sections.heading: Who We Are
sections.text: This store is operated by [INSERT REGISTERED COMPANY NAME], registered in Sweden (organisation number [INSERT SWEDISH ORG. NUMBER, e.g. 556XXX-XXXX], VAT number [INSERT VAT NUMBER, e.g. SE556XXXXXXXX01]), registered address: [INSERT REGISTERED BUSINESS ADDRESS]. You can reach us at cool@arcticflow.com.

sections.heading: Business Model
sections.text: We are a retailer. Products are sourced from third-party suppliers and shipped to you, sometimes directly from the supplier. We select suppliers based on our own review process; this is not a guarantee against any and all defects, but faulty or misdescribed goods remain covered by the statutory rights described in our Returns & Refunds policy.

sections.heading: Product Descriptions & Images
sections.text: We make every reasonable effort to ensure product descriptions, images, and specifications are accurate. Product photos are genuine representations of the specific item for sale unless a product page explicitly states the image is illustrative/stock and may differ from the actual product. If an item you receive does not match its description, this is covered by your statutory rights, not excluded by this clause.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.text: All prices shown include 25% VAT (moms) where applicable. We may correct genuine pricing errors before an order is confirmed. If a pricing error is discovered after you have paid, we will contact you and give you the option to confirm the order at the correct price or cancel it for a full refund. We will not change the price of an order you have already placed and paid for.

sections.heading: Product Claims & Ratings
sections.text: Technical ratings shown on product pages (for example UPF, SPF, IPX water-resistance, or BTU figures) are the manufacturer's reported specifications. We do not independently re-test every item. For uses where a rating is safety-critical — sun or insect protection, flotation, or water resistance — please verify the manufacturer's documentation is sufficient for your specific need before relying on it, particularly for children or for medical/health-related use.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.text: Nothing in these terms excludes or limits our liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, for fraud, or for anything that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited under the law of your country of residence, including your statutory consumer guarantee rights and rights under applicable product liability law. Subject to that, our liability for indirect or consequential loss is excluded to the extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: Intended Use
sections.text: Products are sold for ordinary consumer use and are not intended for medical, veterinary, or professional/industrial use unless explicitly stated on the product page. Pool and garden chemicals must be used and stored according to the safety information on their packaging.

sections.heading: Governing Law & Your Right to Go to Court
sections.text: These terms do not deprive you of the protection of any mandatory consumer-protection law of the country in which you live. You may always bring a claim in the courts of your own country of residence, and Swedish/EU customers may use ARN or the EU ODR platform as described in our Returns & Refunds policy. We will not require you to submit to binding arbitration unless you agree to it after a dispute has arisen.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: We collect only the information needed to process orders and respond to inquiries, and we never sell your personal data. This policy explains your rights under the GDPR.

sections.heading: Who Is Responsible For Your Data
sections.text: [INSERT REGISTERED COMPANY NAME] ([INSERT REGISTERED BUSINESS ADDRESS]) is the data controller for personal data collected through this site. Contact us at cool@arcticflow.com for any privacy question or request.

sections.heading: What We Collect
sections.text: Name, email, phone, shipping/billing address, and order details when you purchase or contact us. Basic technical/browsing data via cookies needed for the site to function. We only set non-essential (analytics/marketing) cookies if you consent via our cookie banner.

sections.heading: Why We Process It, and On What Legal Basis
sections.text: To fulfil your order and provide support (performance of a contract); to keep accounting records (legal obligation); to keep the site secure and prevent fraud (legitimate interest); and to send marketing emails only if you have opted in (consent, which you can withdraw at any time).

sections.heading: Who We Share It With
sections.text: Fulfilment partners and shipping carriers, to deliver your order; payment processors, to process your payment (we do not store your full card number); and, only where required, tax or law-enforcement authorities. We do not sell or rent your personal data.

sections.heading: How Long We Keep It
sections.text: Order and invoice records are kept for 7 years to comply with the Swedish Bookkeeping Act (Bokföringslagen) and equivalent accounting rules. Other personal data is deleted once it is no longer needed for the purpose it was collected for.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.text: Under the GDPR you can ask us for access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, object to or restrict certain processing, and request your data in a portable format. Email cool@arcticflow.com — we respond within 30 days. You can also lodge a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten, IMY, www.imy.se) or your local data protection authority.

sections.heading: Marketing Emails
sections.text: We only send marketing emails to customers who have actively opted in (no pre-ticked boxes). Every marketing email includes a one-click unsubscribe link.
